problem.title: 给没有空格的句子断词
problem.description:
一段文章去掉了所有空格和标点、全部变成小写，变成了一个长字符串。给你一本词典，请把字符串断成若干段，使得不在词典里的字符尽可能少：一段如果正好是词典里的单词，它的字符就算“认出来了”，其余字符都算未识别。输出最少的未识别字符数。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.13。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 150），第二行 n 个由小写字母组成的单词（长度 1 到 100）。
第三行是句子，由小写字母组成，长度 1 到 1000。
problem.output: 一个整数，最少的未识别字符数。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 的句子是 thecatsatonthemat，词典里有 the、cat、sat、on、mat、at。断成 the cat sat on the mat，全部认出，答案是 0。
样例 2 中 brownfox 只能认出 fox，剩下的 5 个字符认不出来。
hints: 设 f[i] 是前 i 个字符的最少未识别数：第 i 个字符单独不认识，f[i] = f[i-1] + 1；如果某个词典单词恰好以第 i 个字符结尾，f[i] 还可以取 f[i - 单词长度]。
每次都挑最长（或最短）能匹配的单词往下断，是贪心，会错过更好的断法。可以用字典树加速匹配。

en.title: Put the Spaces Back
en.description:
A passage lost its spaces and punctuation and was lowercased into one long string. Given a dictionary, cut the string into pieces so that as few characters as possible stay unrecognised: a piece that is exactly a dictionary word is recognised, and every other character is not. Print the smallest number of unrecognised characters.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.13. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 150) and the second line n lowercase words (length 1 to 100).
The third line holds the sentence: 1 to 1000 lowercase letters.
en.output: One integer: the fewest unrecognised characters.
en.explanation:
Sample 1's sentence is thecatsatonthemat and the dictionary holds the, cat, sat, on, mat and at. Cutting it as the cat sat on the mat recognises everything: 0.
In sample 2, brownfox only yields fox; the other 5 characters stay unrecognised.
hints: Let f[i] be the fewest unrecognised characters among the first i: leaving character i unrecognised gives f[i-1] + 1, and a dictionary word ending at character i offers f[i - its length].
Always taking the longest (or shortest) matching word is greedy and misses better cuts. A trie speeds up the matching.

the cat sat on mat at
thecatsatonthemat

problem.title: 选出最小的 k 个数
problem.description:
给定 n 个整数和非负整数 k，找出其中最小的 k 个数，按从小到大的顺序输出。重复的数按出现次数计算。k 可能为 0。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.14。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 k（1 ≤ n ≤ 20000，0 ≤ k ≤ n）。
第二行 n 个整数，在 0 到 10^9 之间。
problem.output: 一行 k 个整数，从小到大排列；k 为 0 时输出一个空行。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中最小的 3 个数是 1、5、5（5 出现了两次）。
样例 2 中 k = 0，什么也不用选。
hints: 快速选择：以某个数为基准把数组分成小于、等于、大于三部分，看第 k 小落在哪一部分，只递归那一部分，平均 O(n)；选出后再对这 k 个数排序。
维护一个大小为 k 的大顶堆也可以，注意 k = 0 时堆为空的边界。

en.title: Pick the k Smallest
en.description:
Given n integers and a non-negative integer k, find the k smallest of them and print them in increasing order. Repeated values count separately. k may be 0.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.14. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and k (1 ≤ n ≤ 20000, 0 ≤ k ≤ n).
The second line holds n integers from 0 to 10^9.
en.output: One line with k integers in increasing order; an empty line when k is 0.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the 3 smallest are 1, 5 and 5 (5 appears twice).
In sample 2, k = 0 and nothing is picked.
hints: Quickselect: split around a pivot into smaller, equal and larger parts, see which part holds the k-th smallest and recurse into it alone, O(n) on average; then sort those k numbers.
A max-heap of size k works too; mind the empty heap when k = 0.

problem.title: 由其他单词拼成的最长单词
problem.description:
给定一组互不相同的单词，找出其中最长的一个，它能完全由列表里的其他单词拼接而成（至少用两个单词，同一个单词可以重复使用，但不能只用它自己）。如果有多个最长的，输出字典序最小的；如果不存在，输出 none。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.15。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input: 第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 200），第二行 n 个互不相同的由小写字母组成的单词，长度 1 到 100。
problem.output: 一行，找到的单词，或者 none。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中 sunflowerseed 可以由 sun、flower、seed（或 sunflower、seed）拼成，长 13，是最长的；sunflower、sunrise、flowerseed 也能拼成，但更短。
样例 2 中没有任何单词能由其他单词拼成。
hints: 把单词放进哈希集合。对每个单词做“单词拆分”式的 DP：f[i] 表示前 i 个字符能否由集合里的单词拼成；判断整词时，要排除“整个单词就是它自己”这一种拆法。
按长度从大到小、长度相同按字典序排序后逐个检查，第一个满足条件的就是答案。

en.title: The Longest Word Made of Other Words
en.description:
Given distinct words, find the longest one that can be built entirely by joining other words from the list (at least two words; a word may be reused, but a word cannot be built from itself alone). If several are longest, print the lexicographically smallest; if none exists, print none.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.15. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input: The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200) and the second line n distinct lowercase words of length 1 to 100.
en.output: One line: the word, or none.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, sunflowerseed is sun plus flower plus seed (or sunflower plus seed), 13 letters, the longest; sunflower, sunrise and flowerseed can be built too but are shorter.
In sample 2 no word can be built from others.
hints: Put the words in a hash set and run a word-break DP on each word: f[i] says whether its first i letters split into words from the set, leaving out the split that is the whole word itself.
Check words by length descending, then lexicographically; the first that works is the answer.

sun flower sunflower rise sunrise seed flowerseed sunflowerseed riser

problem.title: 在长串里查找多个短串
problem.description:
给定一个长字符串 big 和若干个短字符串，请对每个短串，找出它在 big 中出现的所有起始位置（下标从 0 开始）。不同的出现可以互相重叠。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.17。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行是 big，由小写字母组成，长度 1 到 1000。
第二行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 1000）。
第三行 n 个由小写字母组成的短串，长度 1 到 1000，它们的总长度不超过 100000。
problem.output: n 行，第 i 行先输出第 i 个短串的出现次数 k，再从小到大输出它的 k 个起始位置，以空格分隔。
problem.explanation: big 是 abracadabra。abra 出现在 0 和 7；a 出现在 0、3、5、7、10；cad 出现在 4；x 没有出现；bra 出现在 1 和 8。
hints: 把所有短串插入一棵字典树，再从 big 的每个位置出发沿字典树往下走，经过的每个短串结尾都记下一次出现。总时间约为 |big| × 最长短串长度。
每找到一次就跳过整个短串长度再找，会漏掉重叠的出现；只找第一次出现也不够。

en.title: Search Many Short Strings in a Long One
en.description:
Given a long string big and several short strings, find for each short string every position where it starts in big (counting from 0). Occurrences may overlap.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.17. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds big: 1 to 1000 lowercase letters.
The second line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000).
The third line holds the n short strings: lowercase, each of length 1 to 1000, with total length at most 100000.
en.output: n lines; line i gives the number k of occurrences of the i-th short string, then its k starting positions in increasing order, separated by spaces.
en.explanation: big is abracadabra. abra starts at 0 and 7; a at 0, 3, 5, 7 and 10; cad at 4; x nowhere; bra at 1 and 8.
hints: Insert all short strings into a trie, then walk the trie from every position of big, recording an occurrence at each short string's end you pass. The cost is about |big| times the longest short string.
Jumping past a whole match before searching again misses overlapping occurrences, and finding only the first one is not enough either.

cases.input:
abracadabra
5
abra a cad x bra

bbaaabaaabbbbbabaabaaaabbaaaaa
10
bb aabaaabb b bb aaba aa aaabb ab baa ba

problem.title: 包含全部目标数的最短区间
problem.description:
给定一个长数组 big 和一个元素互不相同的短数组 small，请在 big 中找出最短的连续区间 [l, r]（下标从 0 开始），使它包含 small 中的每一个数（顺序不限）。如果有多个最短区间，取 l 最小的；如果找不到，输出 -1。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.18。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n ≤ 100000，1 ≤ m ≤ 100000）。
第二行 n 个整数是 big，第三行 m 个互不相同的整数是 small，所有数的绝对值不超过 10^9。
problem.output: 找到时输出一行 l r，否则输出 -1。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中 big 是 4 2 8 4 6 2 9 8，small 是 2 4 8。下标 0 到 2 的 4 2 8 包含全部三个数，长度 3 是最短的；下标 1 到 3 的 2 8 4 一样短，但起点更靠右，所以答案是 0 2。
样例 2 中 big 里没有 5。
hints: 滑动窗口：右端点向右扩，用哈希表统计窗口内每个目标数的个数；当窗口已经包含全部目标数时，尽量右移左端点缩短窗口，并更新答案。
只在严格更短时更新答案，才能保留 l 最小的区间。找到第一个可行窗口就停下是不对的，后面可能有更短的。

en.title: The Shortest Range Holding Every Target
en.description:
Given a long array big and a short array small of distinct values, find the shortest contiguous range [l, r] of big (indices from 0) that contains every value of small (in any order). If several are shortest, take the smallest l; if none exists, print -1.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.18. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 100000, 1 ≤ m ≤ 100000).
The second line holds the n values of big and the third the m distinct values of small, all with absolute value at most 10^9.
en.output: One line l r when a range exists, otherwise -1.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, big is 4 2 8 4 6 2 9 8 and small is 2 4 8. Indices 0 to 2, holding 4 2 8, contain all three values, and length 3 is the shortest; indices 1 to 3, 2 8 4, are just as short but start later, so the answer is 0 2.
In sample 2, big has no 5.
hints: Sliding window: extend the right end, counting each target inside the window in a hash map; once all targets are in, move the left end right as far as possible and update the answer.
Update only on a strictly shorter window to keep the smallest l. Stopping at the first valid window is wrong; a shorter one may come later.

problem.title: 少了哪两个数
problem.description:
1 到 N 这 N 个整数里恰好少了两个，剩下的 N-2 个打乱顺序后给你。请找出少掉的两个数。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.19。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 N（3 ≤ N ≤ 50000）。
第二行 N-2 个互不相同的整数，都在 1 到 N 之间。
problem.output: 一行两个整数，从小到大输出少掉的两个数。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中 N = 6，给出的是 6 1 3 4，少了 2 和 5。
样例 2 中 N = 3，只给出 2，少了 1 和 3。
hints: 用 1 到 N 的总和减去给出的数之和，得到两个缺失数之和 s。较小的那个一定不超过 s/2，再对 1 到 s/2 求一次和，减去其中给出的数，就得到较小的数。
也可以用异或：所有数异或起来得到两个缺失数的异或值，按它最低位的 1 把数分成两组分别异或。如果用平方和联立方程，要注意平方和会超出 32 位整数。

en.title: The Two Missing Numbers
en.description:
Exactly two of the integers 1 to N are missing; the other N-2 are given in some order. Find the two missing numbers.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.19. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer N (3 ≤ N ≤ 50000).
The second line holds N-2 distinct integers between 1 and N.
en.output: One line with the two missing numbers in increasing order.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, N = 6 and the numbers given are 6 1 3 4; 2 and 5 are missing.
In sample 2, N = 3 and only 2 is given; 1 and 3 are missing.
hints: The sum of 1 to N minus the given sum is the sum s of the two missing numbers. The smaller one is at most s/2; summing 1 to s/2 and subtracting the given numbers up to s/2 yields it.
XOR works too: XOR everything to get the two numbers' XOR, then split by its lowest set bit and XOR each group. If you solve with the sum of squares instead, mind that it overflows 32 bits.

problem.title: 一次改一个字母的单词接龙
problem.description:
给定起始单词 begin、目标单词 end 和一个单词表，所有单词长度相同。每一步可以改动当前单词的一个字母，但改完的单词必须在单词表里。请找出从 begin 变到 end 的最短变换序列（包括 begin 和 end）；如果最短序列有多条，输出字典序最小的那一条（从第一个单词开始逐个比较）。begin 不必在单词表里，end 必须在单词表里才能到达。无法到达时输出 none。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.22。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个单词 begin 和 end（begin ≠ end）。
第二行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 5000），第三行 n 个互不相同的单词。所有单词由小写字母组成，长度都等于 begin 的长度，在 1 到 10 之间。
problem.output: 可以到达时，输出一行：先是序列中的单词个数 k，再是这 k 个单词，以空格分隔。否则输出 none。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中 lead → load → goad → gold 用了 3 步，是最短的；lead → lean → loan → … 都更长。所以输出 4 lead load goad gold。
样例 2 中单词表里没有 gold，无法到达。
hints: 先从 end 出发做一次 BFS（每个单词的邻居是只差一个字母的单词），得到每个单词到 end 的距离；再从 begin 出发，每一步走向距离减一的邻居中字典序最小的那个。
生成邻居时，可以对每个位置尝试 26 个字母，再查哈希集合。普通的 DFS 找到的路径不一定最短。

en.title: Change One Letter at a Time
en.description:
Given a start word begin, a target word end and a word list, all of one length: each step changes one letter of the current word, and the new word must be in the list. Find the shortest sequence of words from begin to end (both included); if several shortest ones exist, print the lexicographically smallest (comparing word by word from the first). begin need not be in the list; end must be in it to be reachable. If end cannot be reached, print none.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.22. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds begin and end (begin ≠ end).
The second line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 5000) and the third line n distinct words. All words are lowercase and as long as begin, 1 to 10 letters.
en.output: When reachable, one line: the number k of words in the sequence, then those k words, separated by spaces. Otherwise none.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, lead → load → goad → gold takes 3 steps, the fewest; routes through lean and loan are longer. The output is 4 lead load goad gold.
In sample 2 the list lacks gold, so it cannot be reached.
hints: Run a BFS from end first (neighbours differ in one letter) to get every word's distance to end; then walk from begin, always moving to the smallest neighbour one step closer.
Generate neighbours by trying all 26 letters at each position and checking a hash set. A plain DFS finds a path, not necessarily a shortest one.

cases.input:

8
lean load loan goad gold goal toad lend

cases.input:

4
lean load goad goal

problem.title: 四条边都是黑色的最大方阵
problem.description:
一个 n×n 的方阵，每个格子是 0（黑）或 1（白）。请找出四条边全由黑色格子组成的最大正方形子方阵（内部不作要求）。输出它左上角的行号、列号（从 0 开始）和边长；有多个最大的时，取行号最小的，行号相同取列号最小的。没有任何黑格时输出 -1。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.23。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 150）。
接下来 n 行，每行一个长度为 n 的由 0 和 1 组成的字符串。
problem.output: 一行三个整数 r c size，或者 -1。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中以 (0,1) 为左上角、边长为 3 的正方形四条边都是 0，中间的 1 不影响；没有更大的。
样例 2 全是白格。
hints: 预处理每个格子向右、向下连续 0 的个数。以 (r, c) 为左上角、边长为 s 的正方形合法，当且仅当左上角向右、向下都至少有 s 个 0，右上角向下、左下角向右也都至少有 s 个 0。
枚举左上角，边长从可能的最大值往小试，总时间 O(n^3)。只看外框，不要求内部也全黑。

en.title: The Largest Square With Black Borders
en.description:
An n by n grid has cells 0 (black) and 1 (white). Find the largest square whose four borders are all black cells (its inside does not matter). Print its top-left row and column (from 0) and its side length; among several largest, take the smallest row, then the smallest column. If there is no black cell, print -1.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.23. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 150).
Each of the next n lines holds a string of n characters 0 and 1.
en.output: One line r c size, or -1.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the square with top-left (0,1) and side 3 has black borders; the 1 in its middle does not matter, and nothing is larger.
Sample 2 is all white.
hints: Precompute, for every cell, how many consecutive 0s run right and down from it. A square with top-left (r, c) and side s is valid when that corner has at least s zeros to the right and down, the top-right corner at least s downward and the bottom-left corner at least s to the right.
Try every top-left corner with sides from the largest possible down: O(n^3). Only the frame counts; the inside need not be black.

problem.title: 和最大的子矩阵
problem.description:
给定一个 n 行 m 列的整数矩阵，从中选出一个非空的子矩阵（连续的若干行与连续的若干列交叉形成的矩形），使其中所有元素的和最大。输出这个最大的和。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.24。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行两个整数 n 和 m（1 ≤ n, m ≤ 100）。
接下来 n 行，每行 m 个整数，绝对值不超过 1000。
problem.output: 一个整数，最大的子矩阵和。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中由第 0~2 行、第 1~2 列组成的子矩阵 4 5 / 6 1 / -2 3 的和为 17，是最大的。
样例 2 中所有数都是负数，最好的选择是只选 -1 这一个元素。
hints: 枚举上边界和下边界，把这几行按列压缩成一个一维数组（每列求和），问题就变成一维的最大子数组和，用 Kadane 算法 O(m) 求解。总时间 O(n^2·m)。
子矩阵不能为空：全是负数时答案是最大的那个负数，而不是 0。

en.title: The Submatrix With the Largest Sum
en.description:
Given an n by m integer matrix, choose a non-empty submatrix (the rectangle where a run of consecutive rows meets a run of consecutive columns) whose elements have the largest sum. Print that sum.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.24. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds two integers n and m (1 ≤ n, m ≤ 100).
Each of the next n lines holds m integers with absolute value at most 1000.
en.output: One integer: the largest submatrix sum.
en.explanation:
In sample 1, rows 0–2 and columns 1–2 form the submatrix 4 5 / 6 1 / -2 3 with sum 17, the largest.
In sample 2 every number is negative, and the best choice is the single element -1.
hints: Fix the top and bottom rows and squash them into one array of column sums; the problem becomes the one-dimensional maximum subarray, solved by Kadane's algorithm in O(m). O(n^2·m) in all.
The submatrix cannot be empty: with only negative numbers the answer is the largest of them, not 0.

problem.title: 单词组成的最大矩形
problem.description:
给定一个单词表，请用表里的单词拼出一个字母矩形：每一行从左到右读是表里的一个单词，每一列从上到下读也是表里的一个单词（同一个单词可以用多次；所有行一样长，所有列也一样长）。求这样的矩形面积（行数乘以列数）最大是多少；如果一个都拼不出来，输出 0。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.25。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 200）。
第二行 n 个互不相同的单词，由小写字母组成，长度 1 到 6。
problem.output: 一个整数，最大面积。
problem.explanation:
样例 1 中三行 cat / are / ten 的三列从上到下读也是 cat、are、ten，面积为 9；表里没有更长的单词，拼不出更大的矩形。
样例 2 中拼不出任何矩形：只有一行时每列是单个字母，而表里没有单字母的单词；两行 ab / cd 的列 ac、bd 也不在表里。
hints: 按面积从大到小枚举矩形的宽（行单词的长度）和高（列单词的长度），一行一行地回溯填入单词；每填一行，检查每一列目前读出的字母串是不是某个“长度等于高”的单词的前缀，用字典树或前缀集合剪枝。
填满之后，每一列必须恰好是一个长度等于高的单词，只是更长单词的前缀不行。正方形之外的长方形也要考虑。

en.title: The Largest Rectangle of Words
en.description:
Given a word list, build a rectangle of letters in which every row, read left to right, is a word from the list and every column, read top to bottom, is also a word from the list (words may repeat; all rows have one length and all columns another). Find the largest possible area (rows times columns); if no rectangle can be built, print 0.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.25. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200).
The second line holds n distinct lowercase words of length 1 to 6.
en.output: One integer: the largest area.
en.explanation:
In sample 1 the three rows cat / are / ten read cat, are and ten down the columns too: area 9. The list has no longer words, so nothing larger fits.
In sample 2 no rectangle can be built: with one row each column is a single letter, and the list has no one-letter words; the two rows ab / cd give the columns ac and bd, which are not in the list.
hints: Try widths (row word length) and heights (column word length) by decreasing area, and backtrack row by row; after each row, check that every column read so far is a prefix of some word whose length equals the height, using a trie or a prefix set to prune.
When the rectangle is full, every column must be exactly a word of that length; a prefix of a longer word does not count. Rectangles that are not squares count too.

problem.title: 稀疏文档的相似度
problem.description:
有 n 篇文档，编号 0 到 n-1，每篇文档是一组互不相同的整数（可以理解为其中出现的词的编号）。两篇文档的相似度定义为：两组整数的交集大小除以并集大小。请找出所有相似度大于 0 的文档对，输出它们的相似度。
为了避免浮点误差，相似度用最简分数 p/q 表示。

出处：《程序员面试金典（第 6 版）》面试题 17.26。题面、样例和测试数据由 CSWork 重新编写。
problem.input:
第一行一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 500）。
接下来 n 行，第 i 行先是文档 i 的整数个数 k（1 ≤ k ≤ 500），再是 k 个互不相同的整数（0 到 10^5 之间）。所有文档的整数总数不超过 50000。
problem.output:
第一行一个整数 c，表示相似度大于 0 的文档对的个数。
接下来 c 行，每行 i j p/q（i < j），按 i 从小到大、i 相同按 j 从小到大排列。
hints: 文档多而每篇很稀疏时，两两求交集很浪费。建立倒排表：对每个整数记下包含它的文档，再对每个整数，把列表里的文档两两计数，就得到每对文档的交集大小；并集大小 = |A| + |B| - 交集。
用最大公约数把分数化简。并集要减去交集，不然算出来的是交集除以两边大小之和。

en.title: Similarity of Sparse Documents
en.description:
There are n documents numbered 0 to n-1, each a set of distinct integers (think of word ids). The similarity of two documents is the size of their intersection divided by the size of their union. Find every pair of documents with similarity above 0 and print the similarity.
To avoid floating-point error, print the similarity as a reduced fraction p/q.

Source: Cracking the Coding Interview (6th ed.), CtCI 17.26. Statement, examples and tests written by CSWork.
en.input:
The first line holds an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 500).
Line i of the next n lines starts with k, the number of integers in document i (1 ≤ k ≤ 500), followed by k distinct integers from 0 to 10^5. All documents hold at most 50000 integers together.
en.output:
The first line holds c, the number of pairs with similarity above 0.
Each of the next c lines holds i j p/q (i < j), ordered by i and then by j.
en.explanation: In sample 1, document 0 = {1, 2, 3} and document 1 = {2, 3, 4, 5} share {2, 3} out of {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}: 2/5. Document 0 and document 2 = {3, 9} share {3} out of 4 numbers: 1/4. Documents 1 and 2 share {3} out of 5: 1/5. Document 3 = {7} shares nothing.
hints: With many sparse documents, intersecting every pair wastes time. Build an inverted index from each integer to the documents holding it, then count every pair within each list to get the intersection sizes; the union is |A| + |B| - intersection.
Reduce fractions with the greatest common divisor, and subtract the intersection from the union, or you compute intersection over the sum of both sizes.
